rationale: The plan matches the reference on every point: DESeq2 Wald on ~ condition with control explicitly releveled as reference and the contrast (condition, lesional, control) stated with direction, apeglm shrinkage, BH at alpha 0.05 passed to results() with independent filtering on, and an edgeR QL cross-check. QC is complete and design-specific — blind VST, PCA on top 500 genes, distance heatmap, per-sample library size/detected genes/size factor table, with sample_01 kept by default, removal only with a stated non-depth reason, and a leave-one-out sensitivity fit reporting concordance. The pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, justified by smallest group size) is minimal, and normalization stays inside the model (median-of-ratios, TMM). Enrichment uses fgsea preranked on the full tested list with the Wald statistic as the stated metric, human Hallmark MSigDB 2026.1 named with version, 15-500 size window applied after intersection, tested genes as the universe, seed recorded, and ORA explicitly avoided on short lists; the report step names versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, NA categories, and the design caveats.
